text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rice got a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A kind person who took useless Rice's hand, just like the big brother in a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A kind person who took useless Rice's hand, just like the big sister in a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I couldn't help but feel that way.
That, after all, I truly want to become a "Blue Rose."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Not a useless girl who brings bad luck,
but a wonderful being who can bring happiness—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just a little longer until training time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll go for
just a little run.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Rice Shower, bathed in cheers,
now steps up to the gate――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kyauu!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I hear Miss Bourbon set another record!
The star of next year's Classics has already been decided!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was such incredible running! Hey, hey,
Bourbon-san! Please, let me talk to you...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I still have some of my quota left to finish.
Please excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeek~~~~!! So cooool~~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. The course is
packed with spectators...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
......Right now, Rice would just be
in the way if she ran... wouldn't she?
—And so begins our challenge of the Twinkle Series alongside Rice Shower!
With a heart full of anticipation, I head to the meeting place, and...
...Rice Shower was nowhere to be found.
Still, there are five minutes left until the scheduled time. I'm sure once the clock strikes—
...She didn't come.
However, to not hear from her by this hour means something must have happened. Just where on earth could she have gone...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What do I do? It really has to be
all over by now, right...? *sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? Why are you here... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm so sorry!
I couldn't make it in time... for our training session.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, while I was running outside,
the usual road was... under construction."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I took a detour and ended up getting lost...
And I kept getting caught by red lights, over and over...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Look at what time
it's gotten to beeee...
choice_data_list: As long as you're safe, that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No, you can't...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
After all... Rice went and ruined
the training you worked so hard to plan...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... if it's really okay with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...P-Please tell me everything
that was on the menu for today, please...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice doesn't want to stay useless forever...
So even on my own, I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I-Is that bad?
Was it... even more of a nuisance?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawa!?
choice_data_list: You're not alone. Let's do our best "together."

text_block_list.text:
...And so, the days of taking on the Twinkle Series
alongside Rice Shower began.
